global_invariants: A permission authorizes entry into a use case; it never bypasses domain invariants.
Tenant/school isolation is enforced independently of permissions.
Idempotency and concurrency controls remain mandatory for critical writes.
Exports: one business capability *.export per view/report; format variants (PDF, Excel, print) are ALIAS capabilities granting the same authorization.
Offline permission does not imply unconditional offline execution; the offline policy metadata still applies.
Effective school capabilities = standard role baseline + school GRANT - school REVOKE (per school, per standard role), within the assignment scopes, plus temporary exception grants.
Only ACTIVE capabilities appear in the rights editor; PLANNED, DEPRECATED and ALIAS capabilities are hidden.
